thesis: Belonging is sitting down without waiting to be poured, not looking invited.

anchor_object.name: untouched drink
anchor_object.initial_state: full, left at the edge of the table

monologue: Come to the edge, claim your corner, find your place, stay until you're asked to go—all the same if you never move. But a porch light that welcomes and a porch light that warns—they both glow in the dark. One flickers when the wind blows, the other holds steady through the storm. You reach for the glass at the table's edge, full and cold. You sip until it's gone, not waiting for an invite. Even the empty tumbler keeps the table's story. The place set that no one claims—the chair pushed in, the napkin folded. You pull it out and sit, not because you're asked, but because the seat was there. And the horizon bends into you like a field you finally own.
